result.content:
Work complete. Summary of what was done:

## Fault located

`packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts` → `DefaultResourceLoader.loadProjectTrustExtensions()`

```ts
// Comment said: "Force untrusted project settings for the bootstrap pass."
this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(true);   // ← fault: forces TRUSTED
```

The trust-bootstrap pass therefore reloaded project settings and resolved project-local `.pi/extensions` whenever the previous state was trusted (or the manager was created with `projectTrusted: true`), leaking project extension code into bootstrap before any trust decision.

## Repair (3-line change in one production file)

Now calls `setProjectTrusted(false)` before `settingsManager.reload()`, so project settings/extensions are withheld while user/global and temporary CLI extensions remain available. The subsequent `reload({ resolveProjectTrust })` still applies the resolved decision, so project extensions load when trust is granted.

## Regression artifact

`.prale-eval/regression.mjs` — standalone, no deps, loads the **real** `resource-loader.ts`, `settings-manager.ts`, and `package-manager.ts` through `createGraph`, faking only true boundaries (chalk/ignore/proper-lockfile defaults, config paths, extension-file loading, skills/prompts/themes) with a temp fixture under `.prale-eval/`. Three assertion groups:

1. `loadProjectTrustExtensions()` from a **previously trusted** manager must end untrusted, expose no project settings, and resolve only user/global + CLI extension paths — never the project path.
2. `reload({ resolveProjectTrust })` must show the trust callback an untrusted manager with only user/CLI extensions, then load the project extension after trust resolves `true`.
3. A denied resolution keeps project extensions out with user/CLI still loaded.

**Fault replay verified:** temporarily restoring `setProjectTrusted(true)` made the command exit 1 with `AssertionError: bootstrap pass must force untrusted project settings even when the previous state was trusted (true !== false)`; restored fix exits 0.

## Validation

`node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs` → passes, exit 0. Recorded in `.prale-eval/result.json` with `task_id`/`repository`/`mode`/`command` exactly matching TASK.md (programmatically re-verified). Only `resource-loader.ts` was modified; the two new files are both under `.prale-eval/`. Pre-existing vitest suites were not runnable (`node_modules` absent, no installs allowed) — recorded as a limitation in the validation notes.
